title: 从经验中学习有状态的预测性知识
summary: 提出状态知识学习（SKL），使LLM代理从轨迹级反思转向维护显式的、基于状态的预测性知识。通过自蒸馏和强化学习两种算法，代理能自主提取并利用此类知识，在WebShop、ScienceWorld和ChessPuzzles等任务上显著优于现有反思方法。
summary_en: Proposes Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL) to shift LLM agents from trajectory-level reflection to maintaining explicit, state-grounded predictive knowledge. Two algorithms via self-distillation and RL enable autonomous extraction and use, outperforming reflection-based methods on WebShop, ScienceWorld, and ChessPuzzles.
